description: Luxury travel + hotel editorial. Real architecture is preserved exactly (no inventing buildings). Choose subject: hotel hero, rural property, scenic view, drone aerial, lifestyle moment, or interior. If you attach a reference image of a real property, the architecture lock kicks in automatically. Returns the styled prompt stack for your shot and the aspect_ratio to make it at — pair it with generate_image and pass that aspect_ratio along.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional frame shape. Replaces the shape the style uses by default. The answer carries aspect_ratio: pass it to generate_image so the picture is made at that shape.

style.description: hotel_hero = property is the star. rural_property = country estate. scenic_view = pure landscape. drone_aerial = top-down or 45° from above. lifestyle = model + destination. interior = inside the property.

subject.description: What you want to shoot. E.g. "a woman walking through a hotel lobby" or "morning coffee on the balcony".
